text: The gas ethyne, C H , more commonly known as acetylene, is manufactured for use
in the synthesis of organic compounds. It is also used, in combination with oxygen, in
‘oxy-acetylene’ torches for the cutting and welding of metals.
Industrially, ethyne is made from calcium carbide, CaC , or by cracking liquid hydrocarbons.
